1445-1913-4871-8249.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and an artifact creature card in your graveyard.
1445-1913-4871-8249.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Imotekh the Stormlord triggers if the creature that was returned to your hand was an artifact, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

792-4279-5931--216.easyPrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
792-4279-5931--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Funeral Room, Totentanz and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Totentanz ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Funeral Room triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2023-3755-4359-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-6006-6073--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-6006-6073--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Angelic Sell-Sword triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5686-6752.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5686-6752.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1742-5078-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
1742-5078-6650.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

575-1794-3967.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one black card in hand.
575-1794-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Ruthless Ripper
When Ruthless Ripper dies, Yedora triggers, returning Ruthless Ripper from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Activate Ruthless Ripper's morph ability by revealing a black card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.

872-4270-7857.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
872-4270-7857.description:
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Trade Routes' first ability by paying {1}, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Elven Raft-Steerer triggers, untapping Scaled Herbalist
Repeat.

2999-4399-4518-5998.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Impassioned Orator trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Impassioned Orator trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
2999-4399-4518-5998.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

2097-3129-5660-6462-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

560-2034-3209.description:
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by paying at most {4}{G}, creating two creature tokens and returning Sprout Swarm from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by paying at most {3} and tapping two creature tokens, creating two creature tokens and returning Sprout Swarm from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two tapped creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}
Repeat from step 2.
560-2034-3209.notes: The starting cost can be reduced by tapping creatures to pay for Sprout Swarm using its convoke ability, and/or sacrificing those creatures to Ashnod's Altar.

1170-1329-1492-4730.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1329-1492-4730.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Welding Jar.
Cast Welding Jar from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Sparring Mummy.
When Sparring Mummy enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

560-997-4550-5572.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-997-4550-5572.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Dragon Appeasement triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Woe Strider abilities.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-2043-3480-6311.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Urza's ability, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Resolve both Urza abilities, creating two token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
Activate a Radiant Lotus token by tapping it and sacrificing both Radiant Lotus tokens, targeting yourself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying the Radiant Lotus token's ability, targeting yourself.
Resolve both Radiant Lotus abilities, adding twelve mana of any color.
Repeat.

1445-2267-4871-5686.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2267-4871-5686.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

527-5137-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
527-5137-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Selvala's ability by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Soliton's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

225-565-1987-2493.notablePrerequisites:
You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-565-1987-2493.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting Archaeomancer and the mana-producing land.
Orvar triggers, creating a copy of the mana-producing land.
When the land token enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers.
Holding priority, activate the nontoken land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate the nontoken land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger from step 3, untapping it.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking the land and Archaeomancer.
When the land and Archaeomancer enter the battlefield, Archaeomancer and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land token.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger from step 8, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
225-565-1987-2493.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may cast Ghostly Flicker targeting any other permanent(s).

2178-4050-5698.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Ulamog's Dreadsire.
Ulamog's Dreadsire does not have summoning sickness.
2178-4050-5698.description:
Activate Ulamog's Dreadsire by tapping it, creating a 10/10 Eldrazi creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Eldrazi token, adding one mana of any color.
When the Eldrazi token dies, Ulamog's Dreadsire triggers, untapping Ulamog's Dreadsire.
Repeat.

4871-5256-5544.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, targeting any opponent.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers when Forsaken Miner dies, and Forsaken Miner triggers when you commit the crime in step 1.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Resolve the Forsaken Miner trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing the opponent to mill cards equal to Forsaken Miner's power.
Repeat.

339-2011-2582.notablePrerequisites:
None of the involved permanents have summoning sickness.
Opponents can not block and kill creatures you control.
339-2011-2582.description:
Declare Najeela, Ahn-Crop Champion and Jegantha as attackers, choosing to exert Ahn-Crop Champion as it attacks.
Ahn-Crop Champion and Najeela trigger.
Resolve the Ahn-Crop Champion trigger, untapping all other creatures you control.
Resolve the Najeela trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that's tapped and attacking.
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

4050-4871-5010-5243.notablePrerequisites: The Reality Chip attached to any other creature you control.
4050-4871-5010-5243.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {B}.
Golgari Thug dies, triggering itself and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting itself from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

147-3505-5147.description:
Cast Second Sunrise by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Second Sunrise.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Second Sunrise
Resolve the Second Sunrise copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

240-1738-4486.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to increase only Atla Palani's toughness by at least one.
240-1738-4486.description:
Increase Atla's toughness by at least one.
Activate Mirror Entity an arbitrarily large number of times by paying a total of {0}.
Resolve the first Mirror Entity ability, causing all creatures you control to have base power and toughness 0/0 and gain all creature types until end of turn.
All creatures you control except Atla die as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
If Serra Avatar died this way, it triggers, shuffling itself into your library.
Atla triggers once for each creature that died.
Resolve the first Atla trigger, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card, then putting the creature card onto the battlefield and all other revealed cards on the bottom of your library.
Repeat step 7 for each remaining Atla trigger.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining Mirror Entity ability.
